description: Tomato pasta on two hot-air balloons. The big one has the pans, the pots and a counter of three boards that slides up and down its deck; the small one has the crates, the sink and the serving hatch. The balloons drift together and apart.
strategy: The small-balloon chef fetches pasta and tomatoes, washes up and serves; the big-balloon chef chops, fries and boils. There are only two plates, so wash them the moment they come back, and throw across when the balloons are apart.
